purpose: Keep tradition terms searchable without erasing spelling, diacritics, scripts, or community preference.
rules: Store the form used by the source and a plain ASCII search alias when needed.
Do not silently translate sacred or technical terms into generic English comfort words.
Keep variant spellings as aliases rather than choosing one as universal.
Mark uncertainty when a source lacks diacritics, script, language context, or community-preferred transliteration.
Do not generate prayers, liturgies, mantras, Qur’anic text, ritual formulas, or restricted ceremonial words unless the source and community explicitly provide and authorize the text.
